question: Why is update_transaction missing from the 'What assistants can do' section even though it exists in the Rust MCP server?
probes: Check whether dist/ was rebuilt after the Rust change
resolution: The 'What assistants can do' panel reads a hardcoded TOOLS array in web/src/pages/Mcp.tsx; it was never updated when the seventh Rust MCP tool was added. Added an update_transaction entry there and rebuilt the Vite app into the project-root dist/ that Craft Anything serves. Verified the built bundle dist/assets/index-BfcsgalP.js contains update_transaction. The Rust tools() list already had all seven tools.
